From: Samir Patel <samir@scalegrid.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval request: dedicated inference for ScaleGrid - demo

Hi Ben,

We signed up for the self-serve trial last week and have started running inference on a few models. After some initial testing we think we'll need a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput and data isolation. Would love to schedule a short demo focused on Dedicated capacity — specifically throughput sizing, latency SLOs, and rollout considerations.

A few quick context points:
- Use case: real-time enrichment for customer dashboards (low latency is key)
- Expected peak: ~300 concurrent requests during spikes, baseline ~50 rps
- Typical prompt sizes: 120-400 tokens (mostly < 256)
- Budget: evaluating reserved options for Q4 procurement

Are you available this week for a 30–45 minute walkthrough? Priya from SRE will join.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, ScaleGrid
